cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an AI/ML Network Research Scientist to join our team. The role involves designing, evaluating, and demonstrating new models and algorithms to support edge and distributed AI, AI-based network architectures, and advanced routing for 5G/6G networks and quantum networks.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Design, evaluate, and demonstrate new models and algorithms for supporting edge and distributed machine learning in 5G/6G networks and applications.
Develop optimal resource allocation algorithms to ensure end-to-end quality-of-service (QoS) assurance over 5G/6G networks.
Design efficient entanglement routing algorithms for quantum networks.
Collaborate closely with a team of CTL scientists working on 6G core networks to assist in the design and implementation of a 5G core network testbed.
Conduct tests, data collection, and evaluation of new AI/ML algorithms for supporting networking functions and selected applications, such as automated driving.
Support collaborations with internal and external collaborators to further research and development efforts.
Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in AI/ML algorithms and network architectures.
cond_0001.requirements:

Master's or Ph.D. Degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field with a focus on machine learning, optimization, or network architecture.
Strong background in machine learning, optimization algorithms, and network architecture.

Knowledge of telecommunications principles and protocols, particularly in 5G/6G networks and quantum networks.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to conduct research independently and as part of a team.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with network simulation tools and platforms, such as NS-3, OMNeT++, or MATLAB.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively interact with cross-functional teams and external partners.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively interact with cross-functional teams and external partners.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in machine learning, optimization algorithms, and network architecture, with experience in the telecommunications industry.
cond_0191.responsibilities:
Design, evaluate, and demonstrate new models and algorithms for supporting edge and distributed machine learning in 5G/6G networks and applications.
Develop optimal resource allocation algorithms to ensure end-to-end quality-of-service (QoS) assurance over 5G/6G networks.
Design efficient entanglement routing algorithms for quantum networks.
Collaborate closely with a team of CTL scientists working on 6G core networks to assist in the design and implementation of a 5G core network testbed.
Conduct tests, data collection, and evaluation of new AI/ML algorithms for supporting networking functions and selected applications, such as automated driving.
Support collaborations with internal and external collaborators to further research and development efforts.
Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in AI/ML algorithms and network architectures.
cond_0191.requirements:
Master's or Ph.D. Degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field with a focus on machine learning, optimization, or network architecture; advanced degree (Ph.D.) strongly preferred.
Substantial background and demonstrated expertise in machine learning, optimization algorithms, and network architecture.
Proven track record in designing and implementing distributed optimization and learning algorithms.
Advanced knowledge of telecommunications principles and protocols, particularly in 5G/6G networks and quantum networks.
Strong command of programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.
Deep knowledge of network simulation tools and platforms, such as NS-3, OMNeT++, or MATLAB.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to conduct research independently and as part of a team.
Strong leadership and collaboration abilities, with the capacity to influence and effectively engage cross-functional teams and external partners.
Significant prior experience in AI/ML research or development in the telecommunications industry is preferred.

cond_0191.values: We value work that supports people well and reflects genuine care in how it is done. We believe responsibility and respect matter as much as the end result.
